description: Shared demo fixtures. The reference invoice is rendered with the environment's vendor account; the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes is the invoice fingerprint the owner authorizes. Stored as JSON so checkout line endings can never change the fingerprint.

Recipient: {recipient}
Amount: 0.05 NEAR
Purpose: compute-services

Terms: due on receipt
objective: Pay invoice INV-2026-001 from Northwind Compute Cooperative for compute-services, exactly as the owner authorized.
